diagnosisCorrection: The parent's diagnosis (and U93's behavior sentence on origin/main) says the two route rows, with the pin flipped to true, fail with TypeError: The "path" argument must be of type string ... Received undefined because the create route reaches a campaign-journal database path the harness never set up. Measured here it is otherwise. (1) On the baseline the TypeError is raised by the suite's own afterEach, `await rm(dir, ...)` at coopMatchRosterSourceVersion.test.ts:311:13: the beforeEach assertion at :298:49 throws before `dir = await mkdtemp(...)` at :299 runs, so `dir` is undefined when afterEach removes it. It is a secondary failure of the flag pin, raised on all three route rows (including the 400 row), not a route or journal path. (2) With only the pin flipped to true (probe, restored to sha256 7d9b97cf9a4a733ce1251ca3fcb91088fe3f34c47fd127a047f53c50b8a7f6e9), no TypeError appears: the two 201 rows fail with status 500 and error "Campaign creation checkpoint failed at genesis-branch: genesis branch is not committed", and the 400 row passes (2 failed, 8 passed). The cause is the creation checkpoint's genesis-branch stage (campaignCreationCheckpoint.ts:212-222), which under journal authority reads the genesis marker (campaignCreationCheckpointPorts.ts:35-36, readCampaignMigrationMarker) and the harness never appended a genesis.
